answer: The ledge assignment is published and island records each panel. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the wharf graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3080 identities would post 2305 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
